findings: The threaded Emscripten build does not start without cross-origin isolation: 'SharedArrayBuffer transfer requires self.crossOriginIsolated'.
Rust on wasm32 cannot allocate exactly 2 GiB in one allocation (at most 2^31 - 1 bytes); the C build can.
